features.title: Ctrl+letter shortcuts work under non-English keyboard layouts
features.description: Ctrl+V, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+B, Ctrl+G, Ctrl+Shift+D and every other Ctrl+letter accelerator no longer break when the active Windows input language is Hebrew, Russian, Arabic, Greek etc. Shortcuts now match by physical key position (KeyboardEvent.code) instead of the layout-produced character. Fixes #57.

features.title: Enter no longer re-opens the New Terminal modal
features.description: After creating a session, pressing Enter now reaches the new terminal instead of re-triggering the sidebar's New Session button. Focus is explicitly moved into the newly-created xterm once it mounts. Fixes #58.

features.title: Close-session button in the terminal header
features.description: The active session's header bar now includes an X button so you can close the current session without going back to the sidebar - useful when the sidebar is collapsed. Fixes #59.

features.title: All four rounded window corners show a visible border in dark theme
features.description: Top-right and bottom-left corners used to blend into a dark desktop because the hairline sat outside the transparent frameless window. The border now renders inside the app fill so every corner reads the same in both dark and light themes. Fixes #60.

features.title: Branch switcher popover uses the flat New UI style
features.description: The branch dropdown in the titlebar no longer uses the old translucent glass surface; it now sits on an opaque elevation-4 surface with a flat 1px seam border, matching the rest of the IntelliJ 2026.1-style New UI. Fixes #61.

features.title: Workspaces panel replaces Agent Teams tab
features.description: The Inspector's middle tab (F4) is now a Workspaces manager - save the current terminal layout as a named workspace and load or delete saved ones directly from the inspector. Replaces the previous Agent Teams orchestration view.

features.title: Pick a model for every agent
features.description: The New Session modal now shows a Model picker for Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity, not just Claude. Each agent gets a curated chip row of its CLI's current models (Sol/Terra/Luna for Codex, Composer 2.5 and frontier models for Cursor, Gemini 3.x and more for Antigravity); the choice is passed as --model when spawning. Tab and status-bar badges show a short, color-coded model name instead of the raw id.

features.title: Right-click no longer auto-pastes into the terminal
features.description: Right-clicking a terminal used to immediately paste the clipboard. Paste is now explicit (Ctrl+V, context menu, or middle-click where enabled), and every paste path uses bracketed paste so multi-line text no longer submits line by line.

features.title: See the current git branch on every session card
features.description: Each Sessions-sidebar card now shows the working directory's current branch next to the folder name, with a fork glyph for worktrees. Reuses the git info already fetched at session creation, so no extra IPC or refresh.

features.title: Rename a session inline
features.description: Double-click a card's name (or right-click and pick Rename...) to edit it in place. Enter commits, Escape reverts, clearing the field falls back to the profile-derived label. Drag-reorder is paused on the card being edited so the input stays put.

features.title: Apple-inspired UI redesign
features.description: Ground-up visual reinvention: new welcome screen leading with the agent choice, Midnight dark as the signature default (terminal now follows the app appearance), simplified titlebar with a single Inspector toggle, sidebar rebuilt as a three-tab navigator (Sessions cards / Files / History), profiles as a one-click grouped list with pin and delete, and dialogs that match the window's dark tone.

features.title: Resume prior conversations for Codex and Cursor
features.description: The History tab now indexes ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD and ~/.cursor/chats/meta.json alongside Claude's ~/.claude/projects/. Click a session to open in a new tab or right-click to resume in the current terminal - the correct --resume / --continue form is injected per agent.

features.title: Folder pin no longer inherits agent from an unrelated tab
features.description: When you pinned a Claude project in the Explorer while an Antigravity terminal was focused, the History tab used to show the wrong empty state. The fix decouples the pinned folder from the focused tab's agent.

features.title: New Session keeps your working directory when switching agent
features.description: Picking a different agent card in the New Session modal no longer resets the working directory field.

features.title: Persist migrations preserve explicit theme picks
features.description: Users who had explicitly picked a light theme or a non-default terminal palette no longer have their choice silently overwritten by the redesign default. Migration steps now guard against clobbering user picks.

features.title: Antigravity replaces Gemini as the fourth agent
features.description: Google's Gemini CLI is retired and replaced with Google Antigravity (binary: agy). Existing profiles that had Gemini selected migrate to Antigravity automatically on first launch, preserving per-agent args and default args. New brand mark, install hint (curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash), and docs link.

features.title: Per-agent CLI args stay separate per agent
features.description: Editing the args textarea for Codex no longer overwrites your Claude Code args (and vice versa). Each agent keeps its own list saved to the profile.

features.title: Search navigation and async UI races fixed
features.description: Cleaned up races in the Search Everywhere flow where results could open the wrong item under fast typing.

features.title: Improved reliability
features.description: Fixed silent-failure paths surfaced by an internal bug audit.

features.title: Cleaner telemetry
features.description: Missing optional agent CLIs (Codex, Cursor, Gemini) are no longer reported as errors.

features.title: Rebrand: Agentrium
features.description: ClaudeTerminal is now Agentrium (Agent Desktop Environment). New icon set. Backward-compatible identifiers (bundle ID, WiX upgrade code, SQLite location) are unchanged so existing installs upgrade cleanly and keep all profiles and history.

features.title: Four agents in one window
features.description: New Terminal now shows a four-way agent picker with the official brand marks: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor (binary: agent), and Gemini. Pick per terminal, mix them freely in tabs and grid, or bind an agent per profile.

features.title: Brand icon on every tab and grid cell
features.description: Each tab and each grid cell header shows the agent's brand icon between the badges and the label, with a tooltip showing the display name. Auto-cycled color-tag dots were dropped since identity is now carried by the brand icon.

features.title: Profiles are shared across agents
features.description: A saved profile appears no matter which agent is selected. Picking a profile no longer overrides your active agent choice - your pick sticks.

features.title: Per-agent default arguments
features.description: The New Terminal args textarea now uses per-agent defaults. Switching from Claude to Codex swaps the placeholder to Codex's typical flags and populates from your Codex defaults instead. Claude-only flags (--dangerously-skip-permissions, --model, --effort, --continue, --resume, --worktree) are stripped automatically when spawning other agents so profiles are portable.

features.title: Per-agent version detection in Settings
features.description: Settings > Updates now shows a section per agent with the detected version, a Docs link, and a Recheck button. Settings > About lists all four agents with their versions. Two-stage detector: <binary> --version first, then a PATH probe fallback so CLIs like Cursor's `agent` (which has no --version) still register as installed.

features.title: Grid mode fixes (GH #52)
features.description: Layout picker icons now render a schematic of the actual grid (no more 3x3 icon on the 2x2 button). Adding a terminal to a 2x2 grid stays 2x2 until it's actually full instead of silently switching to 1x3. Stale 'Terminal not found' cells auto-remove themselves after a restart.

features.title: Ctrl+Tab switches tabs
features.description: Ctrl+Tab moves to the next terminal tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab moves back, following the order shown in the tab strip. The shortcut was previously swallowed before it could run.

features.title: Faster UI under load
features.description: Git operations, file-tree scans, in-repo search, and log reads no longer block the runtime - the UI stays responsive while big trees or slow disks are being read.

features.title: Fewer silent copy/paste failures on Windows
features.description: File-tree paths, terminal output, and paste-as-file now route through the reliable clipboard path (fixes WebView2 focus-gating races).

features.title: Monaco diff editor no longer errors on file switch
features.description: Rapidly toggling between files in Diff mode used to throw "TextModel got disposed before DiffEditorWidget model got reset" in the console.

features.title: Log viewer streams the tail instead of loading whole files
features.description: Session logs are read via a seek to the last 512 KB - huge logs no longer allocate the full file into memory per view.

features.title: Telemetry redacts more secrets
features.description: GitHub PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer tokens, npm auth tokens, and Unix home paths are now scrubbed before reports leave the app.

features.title: New terminals no longer open blank
features.description: Fixed a race where output arriving before the terminal view finished mounting was silently dropped - losing the start of Claude's welcome banner could wedge the renderer and leave the tab empty with a stray '[' character. Early output is now buffered and replayed once the terminal attaches.

features.title: Terminal exit status no longer gets stuck
features.description: Removed a false-positive 2-second lock timeout in the terminal exit handlers that could leave a finished terminal showing as 'Running' and fire spurious error telemetry under normal load.

features.title: Diagnostics for the ghost-character bug
features.description: Added timestamped [pty-size] logging on both the frontend and Rust sides to correlate PTY spawn, terminal fit, and resize timing - groundwork for fixing the stray characters some users see after /clear.

features.title: Fixed single-tab strip rendering
features.description: When a single terminal was open with a long label, the tab bar could show just the overflow badge with no visible tab. The overflow measurement now reads a stable container instead of the tab list itself, and the active tab is always kept visible even in a narrow strip.

features.title: Pinned tabs
features.description: Right-click any terminal tab to Pin it - pinned sessions stay at the front of the strip, get a Pin glyph, and survive 'Close Others' and 'Close All But Pinned' bulk actions. Middle-click still closes any tab.

features.title: Show Hidden Tabs
features.description: When the tab strip overflows, a chevron with a count badge appears at the right end. Click it to see the tabs that don't fit; picking one activates it and pops it back into view. Also right-clickable from inside the dropdown.

features.title: Tab height is yours to pick
features.description: Settings → Appearance → Tab height: Small (24px), Medium (28px, default), Large (32px). Matches IntelliJ's New UI editor tab sizing.

features.title: Search Everywhere with source chips
features.description: The command palette (Ctrl+P) now shows visible source-filter chips at the top - All / Terminals / Commands / Hints / Snippets. Ctrl+Tab cycles through them. Matched characters in results render in the accent color so you can see exactly why a fuzzy match ranked high.

features.title: Welcome hub replaces the empty state
features.description: First-launch and no-terminal states now show a proper welcome screen with hero, four action cards (New Terminal / Search Everywhere / Grid View / Preferences), and a keyboard-shortcut cheatsheet - less desert, more onboarding.

features.title: Status bar shows the actual state
features.description: New live 'last event: Xs ago' ticker; git branch chip with ✓ when clean, NΔ when modified, ↑N/↓N when ahead/behind upstream; 'N terminals · M running' count. Everything that used to live in the git dropdown is now visible at a glance.

features.title: Consolidated left tool rail
features.description: All tool-window toggles - Project, Git, Agent Teams, Commands, Preview - now stack vertically in one left rail. Settings pinned to the bottom. The right-side rail is gone, giving the editor its full width.

features.title: Cleaner file tree
features.description: Folder icons now render as uniform yellow by default - much calmer than the multi-color 'per-folder-name' palette. Prefer the colored ones? Flip 'Colorful folder icons' back on in Settings → Appearance.

features.title: Update pill actually looks like an update
features.description: The 'update available' pill in the titlebar is now a real gradient blue chip with an inset highlight, matching the design spec. Session widget in the titlebar gets a filled Play icon tinted by session state.

features.title: Grid cell polish
features.description: Grid mode cell headers now include the pin glyph (for pinned terminals) and a pulsing status dot alongside the maximize/close controls. Focused cells still glow in the accent color.

features.title: Under the hood
features.description: New pure-logic libs for tab overflow math, pinned-tab ordering, palette matching, and grid empty-cell math - 64 new tests covering these paths (363 total, all green). No new dependencies.

features.title: Search Everywhere
features.description: A new Search Everywhere button (Ctrl+P) sits in the titlebar - the one-stop finder you'd hit in IntelliJ, ready to jump to any terminal, session, profile, or command from a single overlay.

features.title: Grid cells feel like cards
features.description: Terminals in grid mode gain a subtle card treatment - bordered, rounded, with just enough elevation to separate them from empty cells and from each other. The 4/6/8 grid layouts read cleaner at a glance.

features.title: Sidebar and header on the new token system
features.description: Rail width, panel width, and header height now flow from CSS custom properties (--w-rail, --w-panel, --h-header) instead of hard-coded pixels. Density and font-scale changes propagate consistently across the entire shell.

features.title: Refined theme tokens
features.description: New semantic color tokens (theme-aware for both light and dark modes), typography scales for headings, and layout dimensions form the foundation for the ongoing IntelliJ New UI refresh.

features.title: Telemetry: no more races on closed terminals
features.description: Writing to or resizing a terminal whose PTY had already exited could race and log noisy errors. That path is now guarded, and error coverage across the terminal command surface is much broader.

features.title: Under-the-hood modernization
features.description: Bumped Tauri to 2.11.5, rusqlite to 0.40 (newer SQLite bindings), Vite to 8, Vitest to 4, and moved CI to Node 22. Nothing you should notice - except things start faster and build faster.

features.title: Live preview panel for GUI projects
features.description: A new right-docked Preview panel renders your dev server side-by-side with the terminal. Detects the URL automatically from Vite, Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Remix, Angular, CRA, and Expo dev-server output. Toggle it from the right toolbar or Ctrl+Alt+P. Drag the left edge to resize. Includes URL bar, reload, and open-in-browser.

features.title: Profiles that have a GUI
features.description: Profiles gained a 'Has GUI preview' checkbox with optional URL override - terminals launched from a GUI profile open the preview panel automatically. Ad-hoc terminals get a subtle inline hint when a dev-server URL is detected.

features.title: Preview allow-list
features.description: Localhost is always allowed. To preview through a tunnel, add hostname globs (e.g. *.ngrok.io) in Settings → Preview. Anything outside the allow-list is blocked with a clear inline explanation.

features.title: F5 no longer nukes your terminals
features.description: Pressing F5 or Ctrl+R in the app now reloads the preview iframe when the preview panel is open, or does nothing when it's closed - it no longer reloads the whole app and closes every open terminal.

features.title: Security hardening
features.description: Closes a git-injection surface and tightens filesystem-trust checks in the backend, addresses medium-severity findings from a security audit, and disables the WebView2 right-click context menu (Back/Refresh/Save-as/Inspect) at the shell level on Windows so a stray right-click can no longer reload the app and close every open terminal.

features.title: Assorted fixes
features.description: Clicking a session in the switcher now resumes the terminal you actually clicked instead of a different one. Worktree paths render correctly on both Windows and macOS. Dragging a file into the app drops only into the visible terminal instead of every open one. Settings edits no longer clobber each other on quick successive changes.

features.title: No more phantom "Canceled" errors on macOS
features.description: The code editor's WebKit clipboard workaround fired a benign "Canceled" rejection on nearly every editor click - it was two-thirds of all reported error volume and never indicated a real problem. It's now filtered out, in the app and at the telemetry endpoint.

features.title: Editor language-worker crashes are caught
features.description: If a Monaco language worker (TypeScript, JSON, CSS, HTML) crashes, language features used to just silently stop. Those crashes are now detected and reported so they can be fixed.

features.title: Rare copy and tear-off failures are now visible
features.description: A copy that fails through every clipboard path, and a torn-off tab window that fails to open, are now reported instead of vanishing without a trace.

features.title: Accent stripe on selected list rows
features.description: Every selectable list in the app - Sessions, Explorer, branches, session widget, Worktrees, Snippets, Profiles, History - now marks the selected row with a 2 px accent-blue stripe on the left plus a subtle tint. The IntelliJ tool-window selection you'd expect.

features.title: Consistent tool-window headers
features.description: Sessions and Explorer share a single 26 px header primitive - uppercase muted title, count badge, action buttons on the right, and an optional thin progress bar under the header that lights up while the panel is loading.

features.title: Considered empty states
features.description: Empty lists in Sessions, Worktrees, Snippets, Profiles, and History now show a centered stack (muted icon + short title + one-line description) instead of a lonely paragraph.

features.title: Status-bar notification dot
features.description: When a terminal finishes while the app is in the background, the status-bar bell shows a small accent dot. Click the bell to clear it.

features.title: Global progress stripe
features.description: A 2 px accent stripe appears above the status bar while a language server is starting or a git pull is running, so you know work is in flight even when the panel that started it is out of view.

features.title: Tab flashes green when a session finishes
features.description: The active terminal's tab briefly flashes green on the busy → idle transition, then fades back to accent blue. Inactive tabs get the same signal on their underline so you can catch it from across the strip.

features.title: Each terminal keeps its own conversation after restore
features.description: Fixes the bug where text pasted or typed in one terminal appeared in every other terminal tab. When several terminals ran in the same project folder, restoring a session attached them all to the same Claude conversation - one tab's input then showed up in all of them. Restored terminals now always reattach to their own session: a conversation is never resumed twice, and duplicates restart fresh with their previous output still painted above.

features.title: Dedicated to Amit Aflalo
features.description: This release is dedicated to Amit Aflalo. ❤️

features.title: Prompt Editor
features.description: Compose prompts in a full Monaco-based editor and inject them into a terminal's Claude input line - open it with the pencil button in the terminal status bar or Ctrl+Shift+E. Insert (no Enter) or Send (with Enter), continue an in-progress prompt (multi-line prompts are captured too), browse a built-in command guide and your saved prompts, and per-terminal drafts persist while you switch around. Large pastes into the editor can be saved as a file and referenced instead. The shortcut can be toggled off in Settings > Terminal > Behavior.

features.title: Session widget in the titlebar
features.description: A live session switcher next to the branch name: the active terminal's name with a working/waiting/idle state dot, plus an amber badge counting other sessions that are waiting for your input. Click it to switch terminals (waiting sessions sort first) or create a new one.

features.title: Styled tooltips everywhere
features.description: The titlebar, tabs, sidebar, status bars, search, and Git panel now show crisp IntelliJ-style tooltips with keyboard-shortcut hints instead of the slow native browser ones - and they appear instantly as you move between neighboring buttons.

features.title: Scrollback survives tab switches
features.description: Fixes a bug where, once a second tab existed, switching away from a tab and back left it unable to scroll - its history was being discarded. Every terminal now stays alive in the background, so its scrollback (and any output that arrives while you're on another tab) is preserved when you switch back.

features.title: Cleaner, flatter popups
features.description: Dialogs, menus, and toasts no longer paint a blurry shadow halo or blur the background behind them - every popup now sits on a crisp 1px border for a flat, IntelliJ-style look.

features.title: Lighter dialogs with clearer sections
features.description: Dialogs like New Terminal and Profiles are a step lighter, with a distinct header band and hairline dividers separating each section.

features.title: Ctrl+V paste works again
features.description: Fixes a regression from v1.25 where plain Ctrl+V stopped pasting into the terminal and instead sent a raw control character. Native Ctrl+V paste is restored automatically - large pastes are still detected and offered as a file. You can still switch to Ctrl+Shift+V in Settings if you prefer.

features.title: CapsLock no longer breaks shortcuts
features.description: Ctrl+V, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+F and Ctrl+Z now work correctly even when CapsLock is on.

features.title: Tear off tabs into new windows
features.description: Drag a terminal tab out of the window to pop it into its own standalone window, Chrome-style. Detached windows are full duplicates with their own tab strip, and your multi-window layout is restored on the next launch.

features.title: Premium tab drag animations
features.description: Dragging a tab now lifts a ghost preview, slides the other tabs aside to open a gap, and settles into place with a smooth FLIP animation and a sliding drop indicator.

features.title: Closing the main window quits the app
features.description: Closing the primary window now cleanly shuts down the app and any detached windows, instead of leaving stray windows behind.

features.title: Refreshed dialogs and modals
features.description: Every dialog - New Terminal, Profiles, Snippets, Workspaces, Worktrees, Push, Setup, Settings, What's New and more - has been rebuilt on a shared set of UI primitives for a cleaner, more consistent flat IntelliJ-style look, with unified buttons, keyboard-hint chips, and smoother, motion-aware transitions.

features.title: New Terminal button in the grid toolbar
features.description: The grid view toolbar now has a New Terminal button that spins up a fresh Claude terminal and drops it straight into the grid in one click.

features.title: Update button stands out
features.description: When an update is available, the in-app update pill now uses the green accent color so it's easier to spot.

features.title: Per-session cost tracking is now opt-in
features.description: The new cost & token metrics introduced in 1.23.0 default to OFF. Existing installs are migrated to off on upgrade. Enable it any time from Settings > Claude Defaults > Cost tracking.

features.title: Per-session cost & token metrics
features.description: Each Claude terminal now shows live token usage and estimated USD cost - a per-tab cost chip plus a metrics panel breaking down input / output / cache-read / cache-write, with an optional per-session budget cap that warns when a session goes over. Everything is computed locally from Claude Code's own telemetry; nothing leaves your machine.

features.title: Command palette: Recent group, frecency ranking & terminal status dots
features.description: The palette (Ctrl+P) now surfaces your recently-used commands at the top and ranks matches by how often and recently you use them. Terminal results show a colored status dot (running / idle / stopped / error) next to the name.

features.title: Grid view: keyboard pane navigation
features.description: In grid mode, Alt+Arrow moves focus between panes spatially and Alt+1-8 jumps straight to a pane - and plain arrow keys now pass through to the focused terminal (shell history, vim, cursor) instead of being captured by the grid. Navigating also focuses that pane's terminal so you can type right away.

features.title: Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, OS reduce-motion, and light-mode fixes
features.description: Dimmer UI text was lightened to meet WCAG AA contrast, the app now follows your OS "reduce motion" setting until you override it, and light-theme text is correctly dark-on-light (previously some text was nearly invisible on light surfaces).

features.title: Terminal blends with the app theme
features.description: The terminal canvas background now matches the app surface instead of a darker rectangle, and text selection uses your chosen accent color.

features.title: Minimal-UI toggles
features.description: New Appearance > Interface settings let you hide the status bar, hide tab activity indicators, and switch to a compact title bar to strip non-essential chrome.

features.title: Push Commits popup (Ctrl+Shift+K)
features.description: IntelliJ-style push dialog showing the commits about to be pushed, with inline editing of the destination remote and branch. Split-button supports a guarded Force Push (with lease). Also accessible from a new Push button in the File Changes panel header and a Push to remote… entry in the title-bar branch dropdown.

features.title: Colorful title-bar tool icons
features.description: File Changes, Agent Teams, Hints, Settings, Tools, and Recent Terminals each get a distinct accent color (emerald / violet / amber / sky / orange / pink) for at-a-glance scanability instead of the previous uniform gray.

features.title: Settings window: clean defined border
features.description: Removed the backdrop blur halo and replaced the soft glow ring around the Settings modal with a defined 1px border so the dialog edge looks crisp on all backgrounds.

features.title: File Changes panel auto-refreshes
features.description: The panel now refreshes silently whenever the window regains focus, the tab becomes visible, and every 5 seconds while it's open - so the list reflects what Claude (or you) just wrote without clicking Refresh.

features.title: Sessions panel - browse and resume past Claude conversations
features.description: A new collapsible Sessions section above the Explorer lists every Claude conversation stored for the active terminal's folder, newest-first, with a preview of the opening message. Click a row to open it in a new tab; right-click for "Resume in current terminal" (replaces the running Claude in place) or to reveal the .jsonl file. Sessions and Explorer share the sidebar via a drag-resize handle.

features.title: Fix: Restore didn't actually restore
features.description: When opening a session from the new panel, Claude was showing its first-run theme picker instead of resuming. The --resume <id> argument was being parsed by Commander.js as "open picker" plus a stray prompt; we now pass --resume=<id> (equals form) which Commander needs for optional-value flags. Conversations now actually re-attach.

features.title: Restore now actually resumes Claude conversations
features.description: Previously "Restore last session" reopened your terminals in the right folder but Claude itself started fresh - the painted transcript on screen had no relationship to the live Claude process. Now restore re-attaches Claude to your previous conversation: terminals saved by this build use `claude --resume <id>` for an exact match (the session id is captured automatically while you work), and older saves fall back to `claude --continue` to attach to the most recent session in that folder. /clear is handled too.

features.title: Right-click context menu in the Explorer
features.description: Full IntelliJ/VSCode-style menu on files and folders: Open, Refresh, Show in File Explorer (Reveal in Finder on macOS), Cut/Copy/Paste, Copy Path / Copy Relative Path, inline Rename, and Delete (moves to Recycle Bin / Trash so you can recover). Cut items dim until pasted; the root row blocks Cut/Rename/Delete to prevent accidents.

features.title: Stash & Pull when your tree is dirty
features.description: When you click Pull on a repo with uncommitted changes, the File Changes panel now offers Stash & Pull instead of failing - your local edits are auto-stashed, the pull runs, and the stash is popped back so you keep working without losing changes.

features.title: Fix Add Profile stacking on New Terminal
features.description: Clicking + Add Profile from the New Terminal screen now opens the Configuration Profiles modal on top instead of hiding it behind. New Terminal stays mounted underneath and reloads the profile list as soon as you close the editor.

features.title: Faster Claude Code update check
features.description: check_claude_update now queries registry.npmjs.org directly via reqwest with a 5s timeout and a single 400ms retry, instead of shelling out to npm view. Update checks are noticeably snappier and no longer depend on a working npm CLI.

features.title: New Settings panel (Ctrl+,)
features.description: Replaced the narrow modal with a categorized window: Appearance & Behavior, Editor, Terminal, Version Control, Claude Code, Tools, Privacy & About. Live search filters across all settings. New keys: theme mode (dark/light/auto), UI density (compact/comfortable/spacious), accent color picker, UI font scale, reduce motion, notification sound + DND hours, session auto-save interval, confirm-on-close, Monaco editor prefs (tab size / word wrap / minimap / font), terminal shell override + copy-on-select + paste binding, git commit-message template + default auto-stage + default merge strategy, Claude default model + binary path override.

features.title: Changelists in File Changes
features.description: IntelliJ-style local file grouping. Create / rename / delete named changelists per repo, move files via right-click, and Stage all from a list with one click. Mappings persist across commits (sticky). Backed by two new SQLite tables - additive, no migration required.

features.title: Streamlined sidebar - Explorer only
features.description: Removed the terminal list and Tools footer from the sidebar; the file tree now owns the full height. Terminals are still managed via the tab strip and the new title-bar Recent Terminals dropdown (Layers icon).

features.title: Tools moved to title bar
features.description: Workspaces, Snippets, Session History, Session Timeline, Claude Config, Memory Editor, and Manage Profiles are now in a single Tools dropdown (wrench icon) in the title bar. Same modals - fewer clicks.

features.title: Live working indicator on tabs
features.description: A pulsing dot and a shimmering underline tell you which tab is actively producing output. Output-activity based - language-agnostic and version-proof. Respects Reduce motion in Settings.

features.title: Updates ask before installing
features.description: When a new version is detected, ClaudeTerminal now shows a banner with Update Now / Remind in 4h / Later, plus a desktop notification so you don't miss it. No more silent auto-downloads that interrupt your work mid-session.

features.title: Large pastes into the terminal now work
features.description: Pasting more than 64 KB into a terminal used to fail silently with 'Write payload too large'. The frontend now splits big pastes into chunks automatically - multi-hundred-KB pastes go straight through.

features.title: Paste as File (Ctrl+Shift+V)
features.description: New right-side drawer captures large pastes (logs, JSON, stack traces) into a file under .claudeterminal/pastes/ and types a Claude Code @mention so the file is auto-attached to your next prompt. Auto-creates a .gitignore so paste artifacts never leak into your repo.

features.title: Auto-detect large pastes
features.description: When you paste something big straight into a terminal, a non-blocking toast offers Save & Reference / Paste anyway / Don't ask again. Threshold and prompt template are configurable in Settings → Pastes.

features.title: Recent pastes per terminal
features.description: The drawer shows the last pastes for the active terminal - re-open them in the editor or re-send to the terminal with one click. Pastes auto-clean when the terminal closes (configurable retention).

features.title: Customizable terminal appearance
features.description: New Appearance tab in Settings: font family/size/line-height, cursor style and blink, color theme, opt-in BiDi rendering. Scrollback default raised to 50,000 lines (configurable up to 1M). Most options apply live; scrollback and BiDi take effect on the next new terminal.

features.title: Plain shell mode
features.description: New 'Plain shell (no Claude)' toggle in the New Terminal modal - runs a regular cmd.exe/$SHELL so you can launch wrappers like `ollama launch claude …`, scripts, or anything else. Survives crash recovery.

features.title: Zoom keyboard shortcuts
features.description: Ctrl+= / Ctrl++ to grow the terminal font, Ctrl+- to shrink, Ctrl+0 to reset to default. Skipped automatically while typing in Settings or other text fields.

features.title: Title-bar update pill
features.description: When an update is downloaded and ready, a 'Relaunch update' pill now appears in the title bar - no more relying on the Settings tab. The updater also re-checks every 4 hours and on window focus after 30 minutes idle, and downloads in the background.

features.title: Less telemetry noise
features.description: Silenced ~94% of recent false-positive error reports (path-validation outside workspaces, first-run 'no rows' lookups, ResizeObserver loop warnings).

features.title: Crash & error reporting
features.description: Unhandled errors and panics are now sent to ClaudeTerminal's analytics worker so we can fix bugs faster. Windows usernames are scrubbed before sending. New 'Send error reports' toggle in Settings (default ON) lets you opt out anytime.

features.title: Maintenance
features.description: Internal release-pipeline scaffolding for future Authenticode-signed Windows installers via Azure Trusted Signing. No user-visible change yet.

features.title: Unbounded terminal history
features.description: xterm scrollback raised to 100,000 lines so long Claude sessions stay fully scrollable like a regular CMD/PowerShell window.

features.title: Material Icon Theme in file panels

features.title: Cleaner terminal tabs
features.description: Removed the Teleport-to-Web and Remote-Control buttons from running tabs to reduce clutter.

features.title: Collapsible sidebar Tools section
features.description: Footer links (Workspaces, Session History, Snippets, Session Timeline, Claude Config, Memory Editor, Manage Profiles) collapse to a single TOOLS header by default - Explorer claims the freed vertical space. State persists across restarts.

features.title: Maintenance release

features.title: Global file & content search (Ctrl+Shift+F)

Arrow keys navigate, Enter opens the file. Terminal-internal search moved to Ctrl+F so the two no longer collide.

features.title: One-click pull from origin

features.title: Resizable Repositories ↕ Changes split

Backed by a new create_shell_terminal Rust command (cmd.exe on Windows, $SHELL -li on Unix).

features.title: Focus routing fix for stacked terminals
